question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Beseech
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Implore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"beseech"** means to ask someone urgently and fervently to do or give something; implore; entreat. (विनती करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He beseeched the judge to show mercy.
 
 

 
• **"Implore" **refers to making a serious or emotional request to someone; to beg earnestly. (मिनती करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She implored him to stay with her.
 
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'beseech' **is **'implore'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Implore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pamper **(लाड़ प्यार करना): To treat with excessive care and attention.
 
 
• **Example:** She pampered her dog with gourmet meals and luxurious bedding.
 
 

 
• **Impart **(प्रदान करना): To make information known; communicate.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher imparted wisdom to her students.
 
 

 
• **Bequeath** (वसीयत करना): To leave something to a person through a will.
 
 
• **Example:** He bequeathed his entire estate to his children.
